info.name: Ambulance Platform API
info.description:
REST API for an emergency ambulance platform: patient SOS, driver app, hospital pre-alerts, AI triage and dispatch analytics.

**How to run**
1. Import this collection and the environment file.
2. Start your backend on the `baseUrl` shown in the environment (default http://localhost:4000/api/v1).
3. Open the Collection Runner and run folders 0 to 8 in order. Tokens and ids are saved into collection variables automatically.

Roles: patient, driver, hospital_admin (token variable `hospitalToken`), dispatcher.
All coordinates are sample values near Secunderabad, Hyderabad. Change the `lat` and `lng` collection variables for your area.

request.description: Returns `ok` when the API and database are reachable.

item.name: 1. Auth and roles
item.description: Four roles: patient, driver, hospital_admin, dispatcher. Every protected request sends a Bearer token that these requests save into collection variables.

request.description: Creates a `patient` account and returns a JWT. Re-running returns 409 once the email exists, so use Login instead.

exec: pm.test("Returns a token", function () { pm.expect(typeof j.token === "string" && j.token.length > 20).to.be.true; });

request.description: Creates a `driver` account and returns a JWT. Re-running returns 409 once the email exists, so use Login instead.

exec: pm.test("Returns a token", function () { pm.expect(typeof j.token === "string" && j.token.length > 20).to.be.true; });

request.description: Creates a `hospital_admin` account and returns a JWT. Re-running returns 409 once the email exists, so use Login instead.

exec: pm.test("Returns a token", function () { pm.expect(typeof j.token === "string" && j.token.length > 20).to.be.true; });

request.description: Creates a `dispatcher` account and returns a JWT. Re-running returns 409 once the email exists, so use Login instead.

exec: pm.test("Returns a token", function () { pm.expect(typeof j.token === "string" && j.token.length > 20).to.be.true; });

request.description: Use this when the account already exists. Saves a fresh token.

exec: pm.test("Returns a token", function () { pm.expect(typeof j.token === "string").to.be.true; });

request.description: Returns the logged-in user.

item.name: 2. Patient medical ID and contacts
item.description: Stored so the crew and family get useful details when an SOS is raised (shared only with consent).

request.description: Blood group, allergies and a short note. `shareWithCrew` controls whether the ambulance crew can see it.
Reads it back.

exec: pm.test("Has blood group", function () { pm.expect(typeof j.bloodGroup === "string").to.be.true; });

request.description: These people get an SMS with the live tracking link when an SOS starts.

exec: pm.test("Contact has id", function () { pm.expect(typeof j.id === "string").to.be.true; });

request.description: All saved contacts.
Removes the contact saved above.

item.name: 3. Hospitals, doctors and beds
item.description: Hospitals are created by hospital admins, which avoids scraping websites. Nearby search uses PostGIS distance queries.

request.description: A hospital admin registers a hospital with its location, departments and bed counts.

exec: pm.test("Hospital has id", function () { pm.expect(typeof j.id === "string").to.be.true; });

request.description: Hospitals within the radius, nearest first. `emergencyOnly=true` keeps those with an emergency department.

exec: pm.test("Sorted nearest first", function () { pm.expect(j.hospitals.every(function (h, i, a) { return i === 0 || a[i - 1].distanceKm <= h.distanceKm; })).to.be.true; });

request.description: One hospital with departments and beds.
Doctor profile entered by the hospital: specialization, experience, availability.

exec: pm.test("Doctor has id", function () { pm.expect(typeof j.id === "string").to.be.true; });

request.description: Optional filter by specialization.

exec: pm.test("Includes the new doctor", function () { pm.expect(j.doctors.some(function (d) { return d.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("doctorId"); })).to.be.true; });

request.description: Hospital staff keep ICU and general bed availability current. Ambulance matching uses this.

item.name: 4. Ambulances (driver app)
item.description: Drivers register a vehicle, go online and send GPS pings. Location pings feed live tracking and matching.

request.description: Types: BLS (basic life support), ALS (advanced) and ICU.

exec: pm.test("Ambulance has id", function () { pm.expect(typeof j.id === "string").to.be.true; });

request.description: Status can be `available`, `offline` or `busy`. Only `available` ambulances are matched.
The driver app calls this every 3 to 5 seconds. Also broadcast to Socket.IO room `emergency:<id>` when on a trip.
Dispatcher view of available ambulances, nearest first.

item.name: 5. Emergency ambulance flow (core)
item.description: Run these in order with the Collection Runner: SOS, driver accepts, trip progress, hospital pre-alert, completion.

request.description: Creates the request and starts matching. The server ranks available ambulances by road ETA and type, and offers the request to the best one first.

exec: pm.test("Has id and tracking token", function () { pm.expect(typeof j.id === "string" && typeof j.trackingToken === "string").to.be.true; });
pm.test("Starts in matching or assigned", function () { pm.expect(["matching", "assigned"].indexOf(j.status) !== -1).to.be.true; });

request.description: Current status, ambulance, ETA.
Requests currently offered to this driver. An offer expires after 30 seconds and moves to the next driver.

exec: pm.test("Contains our SOS", function () { pm.expect(j.offers.some(function (o) { return o.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("emergencyId"); })).to.be.true; });

request.description: First driver to accept wins. Returns the assigned ambulance and ETA to the patient.
Moves the trip to `en_route`. Pushes a live update to the patient, family link and hospital.
Public tracking link shared by SMS. Works with the token only and shows status, ambulance position and ETA, never medical details.

exec: pm.test("No medical info leaks", function () { pm.expect(j.medicalId === undefined).to.be.true; });

request.description: Ranks hospitals by road ETA, emergency department, matching specialty and available ICU beds.

exec: pm.test("Is a ranked list", function () { pm.expect(Array.isArray(j.hospitals) && j.hospitals.length > 0).to.be.true; });
pm.test("Each has a score and reason", function () { pm.expect(j.hospitals.every(function (h) { return typeof h.score === "number" && typeof h.reason === "string"; })).to.be.true; });

request.description: Moves the trip to `arrived`. Pushes a live update to the patient, family link and hospital.

item.name: Driver: choose hospital and mark picked up

request.description: Sets the destination hospital. This triggers the pre-alert to that hospital's dashboard.
What the hospital dashboard shows before the ambulance arrives: case type, patient condition, ETA.

exec: pm.test("Our patient is listed", function () { pm.expect(j.incoming.some(function (c) { return c.emergencyId === pm.collectionVariables.get("emergencyId"); })).to.be.true; });

request.description: Moves the trip to `at_hospital`. Pushes a live update to the patient, family link and hospital.
Moves the trip to `completed`. Pushes a live update to the patient, family link and hospital.
Rating 1 to 5 plus an optional comment. Only allowed after completion.
Past emergencies, newest first.

item.name: 6. AI assistant (triage)
item.description: Fixed red-flag rules run first, then the language model. Guidance only, never a diagnosis.

request.description: Chest pain with sweating must be flagged as an emergency by the rule layer, with `sosRecommended` true.

exec: pm.test("Disclaimer present", function () { pm.expect(typeof j.disclaimer === "string" && j.disclaimer.length > 0).to.be.true; });

request.description: Mild symptoms get a suggested specialty and self-care advice. The exact wording comes from the model, so tests check structure only.

exec: pm.test("Suggests a specialty", function () { pm.expect(typeof j.suggestedSpecialty === "string").to.be.true; });

item.name: 7. Dispatch dashboard and analytics
item.description: Used by the dispatcher screen. Great for the demo: response times and failed matches as charts.

request.description: Every request not yet completed or cancelled.
Totals and averages for a date range.

exec: pm.test("Has average assignment time", function () { pm.expect(typeof j.avgAssignSeconds === "number").to.be.true; });

request.description: Average time from SOS to arrival, grouped by hour of day.

item.name: 8. Edge cases and negative tests
item.description: Proves the API protects itself. Run after the main flow.

request.description: Anyone can raise an SOS with just a phone number and location. Returns a tracking token.

exec: pm.test("Has tracking token", function () { pm.expect(typeof j.trackingToken === "string").to.be.true; });

request.description: Creates a fresh request for the cancel test.
Patients may cancel before pickup.
Latitude 200 is impossible.
Protected endpoint without a token.
Role check: only drivers can accept.
The main flow already completed this request, so a second accept must conflict.
